title: Ant Group Open-Sources 5 Ming-3.0 Speech Models Up to 126B
summary:
A new set of mixture-of-experts audio models is now available on Hugging Face and ModelScope for public use. Ant Group's AntLingAGI team released five Ming-3.0 models across three functional families: text-to-speech, audio understanding, and automatic speech recognition. The architecture scales from a 0.5B parameter model for voice design to a 126B-A6.5B Flash model for audio understanding and tools.

The release includes an 8.6B A2B model for dialects and a 7.9B A1.3B model for long-form speech, while vLLM-Omni provides day-0 support to serve the weights immediately. Other versions include a 9.3B A2.7B model for efficient dialogue. These models are designed to handle paralinguistic cues and context-aware transcription for a variety of speech applications.

Today, we're open-sourcing 5 Ming-3.0 models across 3 speech families.

- Ming-3.0-tts: 0.5B voice design & paralinguistic cues; Tiny 7.9B A1.3B long-form speech.
- Ming-3.0-audio: Flash 126B A6.5B understanding & tools; Tiny 9.3B A2.7B efficient dialogue.
- Ming-3.0-asr: Tiny 8.6B A2B dialects & context.
